scripts.create_dist: npm run create_package && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run check_licenses
scripts.create_dist_test: npm run create_package_test && npm run lint && npm run test
scripts.create_package: npm run generate_docs && npm run build_engine && npm run build_engine_module && npm run build_website && run-python3 tools/create_package.py
scripts.create_package_test: npm run generate_docs && npm run build_engine && npm run build_engine_module && npm run build_website && run-python3 tools/create_package.py test
scripts.build_dev: npm run build_engine_dev && npm run build_website_dev
scripts.build_engine_module: npm run update_engine_exports && rollup --config tools/rollup.js && tsc --project tools/tsconfig.json
scripts.build_website_dev: node tools/build_packaging.mjs build/website_dev/packaging && node modules/primary-products/tools/build.mjs build/website_dev/primary-products && esbuild source/website/index.js --bundle --minify --define:import.meta.url=document.currentScript.src --global-name=OV --sourcemap --loader:.ttf=file --loader:.woff=file --loader:.svg=file --outfile=build/website_dev/o3dv.website.min.js && esbuild source/website/sessionrecoveryworker.js --bundle --minify --outfile=build/website_dev/o3dv.recovery.js && esbuild source/website/polygonworker.js --bundle --minify --outfile=build/website_dev/o3dv.optimize.js && node tools/prepare_animation_decoders.mjs build/website_dev && esbuild source/website/miniviewer.js --bundle --minify --define:import.meta.url=document.currentScript.src --sourcemap --outfile=build/website_dev/o3dv.mini.js
scripts.build_website: node tools/build_packaging.mjs build/website/packaging && node modules/primary-products/tools/build.mjs build/website/primary-products && npm run build_command_catalog && esbuild source/website/index.js --bundle --minify --define:import.meta.url=document.currentScript.src --global-name=OV --loader:.ttf=file --loader:.woff=file --loader:.svg=file --outfile=build/website/o3dv.website.min.js && esbuild source/website/sessionrecoveryworker.js --bundle --minify --outfile=build/website/o3dv.recovery.js && esbuild source/website/polygonworker.js --bundle --minify --outfile=build/website/o3dv.optimize.js && node tools/prepare_animation_decoders.mjs build/website && esbuild source/website/miniviewer.js --bundle --minify --define:import.meta.url=document.currentScript.src --outfile=build/website/o3dv.mini.js
scripts.test_mcp: node tools/generate_command_catalog.mjs && node tools/build_mcp_workers.mjs && mocha test/mcp
scripts.build_mcp_pilot: npm run build_website && node tools/build_pages.mjs && node tools/build_mcp_pilot.mjs && node tools/check_mcp_licenses.mjs build/mcp-pilot/MCP-LICENSES.txt
